adjudication.rationale: The diff removes the `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts.present? &&` gate in `Topic#expandable_first_post?` (app/models/topic.rb) and does not replace it with any equivalent check against the new `embeddable_hosts` table (e.g., `EmbeddableHost.exists?`). As a result, any topic with `has_topic_embed? == true` will be treated as expandable whenever `SiteSetting.embed_truncate?` is true, even if there are zero allowed embeddable hosts configured. The accompanying spec change in `spec/models/topic_spec.rb` no longer verifies the prior guard behavior (the “is false if embeddable_host is blank” case now doesn’t stub `has_topic_embed?` true / `embed_truncate` true), so this behavior change is effectively untested.
